title: Closing remarks
summary: They wrap up, mention an upcoming set and joke about listing everyone he played with.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’m going to let you get back to work, and see what you shake up this time with the crowd downstairs.

Okay. We’ve got a set coming up I think, I’m not the leader on the set but I think I got a little solo spot. And I was talking to Ross Tompkins and we play this duo thing sometimes now and then and so maybe we’ll play one of the tunes that we played in the past, maybe a Dizzy Gillespie tune if it’s all right with him.
Well it’s been a great pleasure for me, and a moment I’ve looked forward to.
My pleasure. Good luck with these tapings, and I think you’re doing great for music, and great for history.
Well if we run into each other again, maybe we’ll Part Two.
We’ll sit and make a list of all those people you played with, including The Tonight Show.
Okay. Put that in my bio. And then when I send out a bio it’ll be like sending out a huge package. Okay? Good deal.
